test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that correctly expresses the following sentence in direct speech.

She told me that she had already finished the project.

options.text: She said to her, “I will have finished the project.”
She said, “She had already finished the project.”
She told me, “He had already finished the project.”
She said to me, “I have already finished the project.”

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** She told me that she had already finished the project.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"that she had already finished" becomes "I have already finished"**
 
 
• Indirect statement "that she had already finished" is converted to direct statement "I have already finished."
 
• Pronoun "she" is changed to "I" to match direct speech.
 
• Verb tense "had finished" is changed to "have finished" to match the present perfect tense in direct statements.
 
 
 
• **"the project" remains "the project"**
 
 
• The noun phrase "the project" remains unchanged in direct speech.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: "She told me"
 
• Converted to: "She said to me," maintaining the reporting clause.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• Starts with a capital letter "I" and ends with a period ".".
 
• Reporting clause follows the quoted speech, starting with a comma before the quotation mark.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She said to me, “I have already finished the project.”"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "She said to her, “I will have finished the project.”" 

 
 
• The pronoun "her" is incorrect; it should be "me".
 
• The tense "will have finished" is incorrect; it should be "have finished".
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "She said, “She had already finished the project.”" 
 
 
• The pronoun "she" is incorrect; it should be "I".
 
• The tense "had finished" is incorrect; it should be "have finished".
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** “She told me, “He had already finished the project.”" 
 
 
• The pronoun "he" is incorrect; it should be "I".
 
• The tense "had finished" is incorrect; it should be "have finished".
